strongest_angle: Showrunner Terry Matalas revealed that VisionQuest is set years after WandaVision, running current with Spider-Man: Brand New Day rather than in 2024 as star Paul Bettany previously suggested.

key_facts.fact: VisionQuest showrunner Terry Matalas revealed in a September 2026 interview with Polygon that years have passed since WandaVision and the series is current with Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
Paul Bettany originally suggested that the Marvel television show VisionQuest took place in 2024, setting it around a year after the events of WandaVision.
The character Vision was first introduced to the Marvel Cinematic Universe in the 2015 film Avengers: Age of Ultron, where he killed his creator Ultron.
